newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FORECAST - Belgian Dec inflation seen down - poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Belgian Dec inflation seen down - poll.

text.p: Belgian year-on-year inflation was expected to be on average 2.30 percent in December, this month's Reuter poll of forecasters showed.
Month-on-month, December inflation is expected to be practically flat at -0.01 percent.
Inflation stood at a month-on-month +0.15 percent in November for a year-on-year 2.36 percent.
Petercam said that the slight increase of fresh food prices and the impact of rising oil prices were not felt this month. It saw some modest downward pressure because of end-of-year sales.
Official consumer price inflation data are due on Tuesday.
